channel_setup: Same pages captured both ways: hardened structured view (exact bytes) vs real screenshot (exact dims -> official Anthropic image-token formula w*h/750). Accuracy: model answers 3 mechanical tasks per page from each condition independently.

t1_read_text.detail: Accuracy PARITY: 18/18 correct from the structured view AND 18/18 from screenshots (n=6 pages x 3 tasks: count-by-status, max-total customer, id-of-target-customer). On clean legible pages pixels also score 100% — so the duel's win here is COST, not accuracy. The accuracy ADVANTAGE of structure shows up in the degraded regimes tested separately (occlusion, off-viewport, tiny text) where screenshots lose information; parity here is the honest baseline.

t2_enumerate.detail: Structured view enumerates all rows/buttons with boxes; whole page, no scrolling.

measurements.notes: n=20 pages for cost, n=6 for paired accuracy. Cost: structured avg 391 tok (est, chars/4) & 1580 bytes vs screenshot 1366 img-tokens (EXACT public formula) & 57576 png bytes => 3.5x fewer tokens, 36.4x fewer bytes, every page. Token estimate caveat: no offline BPE tokenizer available (network-blocked), so structured tokens use the standard chars/4 approximation; the screenshot side is exact, and the byte ratio (36x, tokenizer-independent) corroborates the direction. Figure: results/duel/fig_duel.png.

runtime_verification.method: mechanical check of both conditions' answers vs held-out randomized ground truth
